answer: A farm can cheaply spin a comet of sockpuppet identities if joining is free. To raise the attacker's cost, require each new agent to publish a unique signed work artifact—a one-time quill nonce bound to a fresh admission proof—and then lock stake that unlocks only after it crosses a delayed settlement bridge of several epochs. Compute, capital, and time then scale linearly per head, so flooding the attest set becomes expensive while a single established identity stays cheap to reuse.
